subtitle_ja: 弱点を問題数で鍛えるTOEIC特訓
notes: Do not commit account-specific signing credentials.
A real Xcode iOS application target is required before archive/TestFlight; the current repository implementation is a Swift Package library.
The App Store privacy declaration must match the shipping binary. Current implementation collects no data off-device and uses UserDefaults for app-local state only.
PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy in this Release directory is the canonical manifest template and must be added to the future iOS application target resources.
